carrier.title: Carrier Earnings & Payouts
carrier.subtitle: Guaranteed {{percent}}% net freight payouts with {{clearing}} and direct bank transfers
carrier.payoutsHoldBody: Your Stripe Connect account requires bank account details or identity verification before earnings can be disbursed to your bank. Please update your account details.
carrier.step1Desc: Upon final Proof of Delivery upload, the {{percent}}% net carrier fare is credited to your account.
carrier.step2Desc: Funds are held for {{days}} days to reconcile automated Gate B mass checks, waiting time detention timers, and sender confirmation.
carrier.step2InstantDesc: With 0-day clearing enabled, earnings clear immediately upon delivery confirmation for rapid payout.
carrier.step3Desc: Cleared funds are transferred straight into your verified bank account via Stripe Connect with zero manual invoicing.

partner.title: My Commissions & Earnings
partner.subtitle: Your share of paid shipments — primarily when senders you invited book freight (or when you hold the job’s origin territory seat)
partner.howYouEarnBody: Commission is paid when a sender you invited books and pays for a job. Inviting carriers grows your Book of Business and local supply — it does not by itself create commission on their trips. If the sender registered directly with CLOX (no invite), the Local share goes to the origin-territory seat or HQ.
partner.bobSubtitle: Senders you invite can earn you commission when they book. Carriers you invite are in your portfolio for relationships and supply — not a separate commission on every trip they run.
partner.referredSendersSub: These bookings can earn you commission
partner.referredCarriersSub: Supply in your book — not trip commission by itself
partner.chartSubtitle: Shipments that credited commission to you
partner.ledgerSubtitle: Your share on each credited shipment and payout status
partner.noSettlements: No commission settlement lines found for the selected period.

revenueSplit.title: Revenue split
revenueSplit.subtitle: Two steps: split gross between Carrier and CLOX, then split CLOX among Super / State / Local. Per-person Stage 2 packages are on Partner performance.
revenueSplit.newAccrualsOnly: Changes apply to new settlement accruals only. Past jobs keep their snapshotted shares.
revenueSplit.perAdminHint: To change one Local or State admin’s Super/State/Local CLOX pool package without affecting peers, use Partner performance → Adjust split.
revenueSplit.nestedHint: Stage 1: Carrier vs CLOX. Stage 2: Super / State / Local of CLOX (must sum to 100).
revenueSplit.effectiveLine: Carrier {{carrier}}% of gross · CLOX pool Super {{super}}% / State {{state}}% / Local {{local}}% (v{{version}})
revenueSplit.carrierLocked: Carrier share is dynamic. CLOX pool Super + State + Local must sum to 100%.
revenueSplit.carrierDynamicHint: Edit Stage 1, then Stage 2. Publish when CLOX shares sum to 100%.
revenueSplit.stage1Title: Split settlement gross — Carrier vs CLOX
revenueSplit.stage1Hint: These two always add to 100% of settlement gross.
revenueSplit.stage1CloxHint: Platform pool to split in Stage 2
revenueSplit.stage2Title: Split CLOX revenue — Super / State / Local
revenueSplit.stage2Hint: Treat the CLOX {{clox}}% as 100%. These three must sum to 100%.
revenueSplit.poolSumClox: CLOX pool sum: {{sum}} / 100% (Carrier {{carrier}}% · CLOX {{clox}}% of gross)
revenueSplit.cloxPoolGrossHint: Reference only — of full gross ≈ Super {{superGross}}% · State {{stateGross}}% · Local {{localGross}}%
revenueSplit.treeStage1: Stage 1 — Settlement gross splits Carrier vs CLOX
revenueSplit.treeStage2: Stage 2 — CLOX {{clox}}% acts as 100% for Super / State / Local

platformSettings.title: Platform settings
platformSettings.subtitle: Marketplace rescue discount, auto re-list SLA, and reliability score impacts.
platformSettings.discountHint: Applied to carrier bid floor on re-listed jobs (0–50). Customer price unchanged.
platformSettings.slaHint: Auto re-list pre-trip exceptions still awaiting carrier after this time.
platformSettings.driverDeltaHint: Points deducted when a driver opens DRIVER_UNAVAILABLE.
platformSettings.carrierDeltaHint: Points deducted when a job is released to the marketplace.
platformSettings.clearingDaysHint: Hold period before completed trip freight clears for automatic bank payout (0 = instant settlement upon POD).
platformSettings.gstHint: Applicable Goods & Services Tax percentage (default 10% in Australia). Used to calculate ex-GST base freight and tax line items.
platformSettings.invalid: Enter valid numbers for all fields.
platformSettings.stateTierCardTitle: State Master Tier Governance & Revenue Routing
platformSettings.stateTierCardSubtitle: Toggle State Master franchise participation. When disabled, State share routes to Super Admin and dispute escalations bypass State directly to Super Admin.
platformSettings.confirmEnableStateTierDesc: Enabling the State Master tier activates the 3-tier franchise model. Active State Masters will receive their designated 10% commission on origin freight, and Local BDEs will escalate disputes to State Masters before Super Admin.
platformSettings.confirmDisableStateTierTitle: Disable State Master Tier (Direct HQ Mode)?
platformSettings.confirmDisableStateTierDesc: Disabling the State Master tier transitions the platform to a Direct 2-Tier governance model. The 10% State revenue split will automatically route directly to CLOX / Super Admin (HQ Holding). All Local BDE dispute escalations will bypass the State queue and go directly to Super Admin.
platformSettings.stateTierEnabledToast: State Master Tier enabled. 3-tier franchise governance active.
platformSettings.stateTierDisabledToast: State Master Tier disabled. 10% State split routed to Super Admin (HQ Holding). Direct 2-tier governance active.
platformSettings.revenueRoutingActiveDesc: Origin 10% commission is allocated to the active State Master seat assigned to the pickup state/region.
platformSettings.revenueRoutingDisabledDesc: State Master tier is disabled. The 10% state commission automatically routes directly to CLOX / Super Admin (HQ Holding).
platformSettings.disputeRoutingActiveDesc: Standard 3-tier escalation: Local BDE triages locally, escalates to State Master, who may rule or escalate to Super Admin.
platformSettings.disputeRoutingDisabledDesc: Direct 2-tier escalation: Local BDE triages locally. All escalations bypass State Master and report directly to Super Admin for binding resolution.
platformSettings.operationalCardSubtitle: Configure dispatch timers, reliability score impacts, holding windows, and tax rates.
platformSettings.pricingSubtitle: Global hard floors, GST, and hourly min hours. Per-vehicle $/km and $/hr live on Vehicle Classes. Legacy global rates remain a fallback if a class has no rate card.
platformSettings.settlementCycleSubtitle: Rolling settlement cadence and autonomous disbursement sweep hour for carrier bank payouts.
platformSettings.carrierShareHint: Share of settlement gross; CLOX pool is the remainder
platformSettings.superShareHint: Share of the CLOX pool (not of gross)
platformSettings.stateShareHint: Share of the CLOX pool (not of gross)
platformSettings.localShareHint: Share of the CLOX pool (not of gross)
platformSettings.cloxSuperShareHint: Share of the CLOX pool (not of gross)
platformSettings.cloxStateShareHint: Share of the CLOX pool (not of gross)
platformSettings.cloxLocalShareHint: Share of the CLOX pool (not of gross)
platformSettings.cloxPoolSumError: CLOX pool shares must sum to 100% (got {{sum}}%)
platformSettings.perKmMinBaseLabel: Minimum Trip Base Fare ($ AUD inc GST)
platformSettings.perKmMinBaseHint: Minimum base fare floor applied to distance jobs (e.g. 50.00 = $50.00).
platformSettings.perKmFormulaDesc: Standard distance formula applied from pickup to drop-off, protected by the trip base fare floor.
platformSettings.hourlyRateHint: Base rate per billable hour (e.g. 80.00 = $80.00/hr inc GST).
platformSettings.hourlyFormulaDesc: Applied across scheduled duration or minimum hours floor for multi-stop freight bookings.
platformSettings.cutoffHourHint: Hour of day when autonomous watchdog triggers automated payout run (e.g. 4 = 4:00 AM AEST).
platformSettings.activeWatchdogPolicyDesc: Rolling {{cadence}}-day settlement window. Automated autonomous disbursement sweep executes at {{cutoff}}:00 AM AEST on the scheduled settlement cycle close date.
platformSettings.saveBannerHint: Changes take effect immediately across all newly created bookings and settlement cycles.
platformSettings.confirmSaveDesc: This will update marketplace operational SLA thresholds, freight quoting base rates (PER_KM and HOURLY), and the automated settlement disbursement schedule.
platformSettings.confirmPublishSplitDesc: This will update the national revenue distribution policy. Future settlement accruals will apply this split.
platformSettings.confirmPresetDesc: This will set the settlement cycle window to {{val}} days in the form. You must click "Save Platform Configuration" to apply the change.
platformSettings.confirmEnableRegionDesc: Enabling {{code}} will allow shippers to post jobs and carriers to receive dispatch offers across this state.
platformSettings.confirmDisableRegionDesc: Disabling {{code}} will suspend new freight bookings originating or terminating in this state and pause carrier dispatch for this region.
platformSettings.revenueSplitCardSubtitle: Stage 1: Carrier vs CLOX of settlement gross. Stage 2: Super / State / Local as % of the CLOX pool (must sum to 100).
platformSettings.regionsSubtitle: Enable or disable Australian states and territories for marketplace operations, carrier coverage, and job matching.
